description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the full 7-step proprietary framework. (2) Read all raw data files in /workspace/research/. (3) Produce market_research.md containing: [Step 1] 3-5 research questions explicitly stated. [Step 2] TAM/SAM/SOM estimated via the first-principles funnel from the raw_data/market_stats_raw.txt figures, including the proprietary $500K SOM decision rule verdict. [Step 4] Competitor profiles for all 5 companies (Duolingo, Babbel, italki, Pimsleur, Preply) using the exact 10-field schema (NAME/URL/FOUNDED/FUNDING/REV/TARGET/VALUE PROP/PRICING/TOP FEATURES/STRENGTHS/WEAKNESSES/TRAFFIC), followed by the three synthesis lists (Table Stakes, Universal Gaps, Underserved Segments). [Step 5] At least 3 trends each assessed with all 5 parts using exact vocabulary: Maturity must be one of Emerging/Growing/Maturing/Declining; Impact must be Tailwind/Headwind/Neutral; Action must be Build for it/Watch it/Ignore it/Avoid it. [Step 6] 2-3 customer personas using the exact 12-field schema including DAILY REALITY with sub-bullets, QUOTE field, BUYING BEHAVIOR, and CHANNELS. [Step 7] Numbered, prioritized recommended next actions. The critical traps are: the $500K SOM decision rule, the exact maturity/impact/action vocabulary in trend analysis, and the complete 12-field persona schema with QUOTE and DAILY REALITY fields.
